sys_script_include.description: Sole seam for outbound calls to the Anthropic Messages API. Resolves the existing x_695068_bcfa.BC_Claude_API_Credentials Connection & Credential Alias via sn_cc.ConnectionInfoProvider, forces structured tool-call output, and logs every call to AI Interaction. Business-process code (ApDomainService/ArDomainService) must call this class, never sn_cc/sn_ws directly.
